Catalogue numbers:

Stash Recordings Are Playable On Both Stereo And Mono Equipment•No Pseudo Or Electronic Re-channeling Has Been Added

Also included is a 10" x 8" photocopied two-sided paper insert which is a glossary of slang terms used on the LP. The STASH logo, their mailing address, and instructions to receive the lyrics free of charge are also printed on it.
